edges.claim: A threaded bottom bracket threads into the frame: the shell has an internal thread that accepts the external thread of the bearing cups, and the shell is part of the frame.

evidence.quote:
Threaded bottom bracket shells have an internal thread to accept the
external thread of the bottom bracket bearing cups or adaptors (figure 7.31).

evidence.section: FIGURE 7.30: Spin cranks to feel for grinding on a worn bott
evidence.quote:
The bottom bracket shell is part of the frame that houses the bottom
bracket bearings and spindle.
